description: Promo projection charts can be used to show how different promotional activities or marketing efforts lead to various outcomes, such as sales, customer engagement, or brand awareness. A promo projection chart is a type of flow diagram used to visualize the distribution and movement of quantities between different stages or categories. Key Components: Promo Projection Chart: Comprises of nodes and their links. Node: Each node has a different label and values to differentiate each node. Node Colour: Represents the type of node. Links: Used to link nodes with specific properties. Basic Features: Visual Clarity: Clear visualization with easily identifiable data. Size: Resizable and adapts dynamically to screen size. Dynamic Data Handling: Manages large datasets with smooth performance and quick rendering. Data Required: Sales Growth, brand awareness, unit sold, rate of interest, e-commerce, retails, modern trade, buy1 get1, bundle offer, free sample. Tool Tip: Displays different properties for nodes and links. Nodes: All nodes like Sales Growth, brand awareness, and more are visible. Links: All edges connecting different groups of nodes are visible. Image: Logo visibility. Calculated Value: Each node’s value is visible inside the node.
